text: {"name":"mac_recompute_state_flag","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Clears bit 2 of the state flags, then restores it when the count, indexed-record status, or selected-record checks meet their thresholds, returning whether the bit is set.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v1":"old_flags","v5":"record","v6":"record_status","v8":"status_subfield"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":136,"meaning":"Start of a table of 16-bit indices into 12-byte records."},{"offset":166,"meaning":"State flags byte; bit 2 is recomputed and the original bit 5 is consulted."},{"offset":168,"meaning":"Selector used to choose an index from the table at +136."},{"offset":177,"meaning":"Byte compared against the threshold 11."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Record-relative word checked against value thresholds."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Record-relative packed status word; bits 12–13 and other subfields are examined."}]}
